cause.fix: Require GroupedMatMul or checked Gather/GatherElements indices to belong to request.inputs during resource qualification; retain native guard, actual checked bounds and ordinary leaf fallback.
cause.terminal_diagnostic: Graph budget termination also retains the last genuine candidate rejection; no budget limit was raised.
